metadata.name: Aptdot Open Color Palette: Design Tokens and WCAG Contrast Matrix
metadata.description: An original 6-hue, 11-step colour palette (66 colours) generated in OKLCH so that each step has the same WCAG 2 contrast on every hue, with hex, RGB, HSL and OKLCH values, contrast ratios against six surfaces, light and dark semantic tokens, and ready-made CSS, Tailwind CSS v4 and W3C DTCG 2025.10 exports.

standards.contrast: WCAG 2.2 success criteria 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced) and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast
standards.tokens: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 (W3C Design Tokens Community Group report)
standards.color: CSS Color Module Level 4 (oklch, rgb and hsl syntax)

hues.indigo: Primary: brand, links and primary buttons

guarantees: Every 500 step has at least 3:1 on white (large text and UI components).
Every 600 step has at least 4.5:1 on white (WCAG AA body text).
Every 700 step and darker has at least 7:1 on white (WCAG AAA body text).
Every 400 step and lighter has at least 4.5:1 on slate-950 (AA text in dark mode).
Every 300 step and lighter has at least 7:1 on slate-950 (AAA text in dark mode).
Every colour is inside the sRGB gamut, so its hex value is exact.
Every semantic text and icon colour has at least 4.5:1 on its surface, and border-strong at least 3:1, in both light and dark mode.

conventions.contrast: WCAG 2 contrast ratio (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), with relative luminance computed exactly as WCAG 2.2 defines it (sRGB, 0.04045 threshold) from the 8-bit hex value. ratio is rounded down to 3 decimals so it never overstates a pass; the pass flags use the unrounded value.
conventions.levels: aa: 4.5:1 normal text. aa_large: 3:1 large text (24px, or 18.66px bold). aaa: 7:1. aaa_large: 4.5:1. non_text: 3:1 for UI components and graphics (WCAG 1.4.11).
conventions.oklch: OKLCH of the exact hex colour. Lightness as a percentage, chroma, hue in degrees; hue is none for greys.
conventions.generation: Lightness was solved per step for the target contrast on white; chroma follows a per-hue curve and was reduced where needed to stay inside sRGB.
